text: Agile methodology is a popular way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritised list called the backlog, which is often written as user stories describing what users need. Every day, team members hold quick meetings called standups to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to test their work regularly, get feedback, and improve the product step by step. As a result, Agile helps teams respond quickly to changes and deliver value to customers sooner.
